description: Start a paper ledger over with a starting balance: sets its cash to balance and clears its positions. Earlier fills stay in its history. Nothing is sent to an exchange. After a reset, each paper fill on that ledger moves cash: a buy takes its notional (quantity x price) from cash and a sell adds its notional; a buy that costs more than the cash fills nothing and entry returns paper_insufficient_cash. Without a reset cash stays null and every order fills. Two forms. With paper_id (the id a no-token paper fill on entry returned) and no token: that one guest ledger. With your user's Autoview account token and no paper_id: the account's paper ledger on exchange, which its first token fill on entry opened or a paper_id claim moved onto the account (paper_ledger_none if there is none). A paper_id claimed by an account no longer works here without the token: reset that ledger with the token form. It also cancels the ledger's open paper limit orders, so none of them fills later against the new cash. Returns { paper_reset: true, exchange, cash, positions: [], cancelled_orders (how many open orders it cancelled), note }. cash is in the quote currency of the symbols traded, unconverted. A refusal returns { error, code }: paper_reset_invalid (exchange missing, or balance not a positive number up to 1000000000000), paper_id_unknown (no guest ledger has that paper_id), paper_id_other_exchange (the ledger is on another exchange), paper_reset_needs_id (neither paper_id nor a token), invalid_token, paper_exchange_out_of_scope (the token is not scoped for that exchange), paper_ledger_none (the account has no paper ledger on that exchange), paper_ledger_unavailable (nothing changed; try again shortly), paper_rate_limited (the paper_id form with no token is limited to 60 per hour from each connection, counted together with paper_ledger; wait until retry_at).

balance.description: the starting cash, a positive number in the quote currency of the symbols you trade (e.g. 1000 for 1000 USDT on BTCUSDT)

exchange.description: the ledger's exchange, e.g. BINANCE; with paper_id it must match the ledger's exchange

paper_id.description: the paper_id a no-token paper fill on entry returned, 32 hex characters; resets that guest ledger with no token. When paper_id is sent, the token is not used

token.description: your Autoview account token — an av_mcp_ personal access token, generate one at /account/tokens/ on the Autoview site. Omit this if your MCP client already sends it as an `Authorization: Bearer` header (Claude Code, Cursor, and most non-browser clients do this automatically once configured). Leave it out when you pass paper_id.

name: paper_reset
